nodes.label: Default to --code-only for routine graphify builds on this repo
nodes.rationale: Code files are parsed locally via tree-sitter with no LLM call, but docs/papers/images go through semantic extraction (Gemini API or the host AI assistant reading file content directly), which counts as leaving the machine; restricting routine rebuilds/updates to --code-only avoids exposing potentially sensitive doc content by default, only dropping the flag when the user explicitly wants docs/papers/images included.
